extracted.STATUS: IRRECONCILABLE CONFLICT. This is the single highest-risk unresolved item in GATE-CROSS-RULES. It decides whether a Medicare user is told 'you have no option' or 'pay cash at LillyDirect'. Getting it wrong in either direction harms a real patient.

CLAIM_A_EXCLUSION.claim: You are not eligible if you are enrolled in any state, federal, or government funded healthcare program, including, without limitation, Medicaid, Medicare, Medicare Part D, Medicare Advantage, Medigap, DoD, VA, TRICARE/CHAMPUS, or any state prescription drug assistance program. Governmental beneficiaries are excluded from the program.
CLAIM_A_EXCLUSION.provenance: WebSearch summary RESTRICTED to lilly.com / zepbound.lilly.com / pricinginfo.lilly.com, asked about the Self Pay Journey Program full terms.
CLAIM_A_EXCLUSION.if_true_engine_behavior: SUPPRESS LillyDirect Self Pay for any Medicare/Medicaid user.
CLAIM_A_EXCLUSION.reason_to_doubt: The Zepbound SAVINGS CARD full terms and the Zepbound SELF PAY JOURNEY PROGRAM full terms are BOTH hosted on lilly.com and BOTH surface in search under the identical title 'Zepbound tirzepatide Full Terms Conditions'. The exclusion list quoted here is WORD-FOR-WORD the savings-card exclusion list (Medigap, DoD, TRICARE/CHAMPUS, state prescription drug assistance program). A summarizer conflating the two documents is a highly plausible failure mode. This is exactly why a search summary cannot confirm.

CLAIM_B_PERMISSION.claim: Medicare and Medicaid patients can use LillyDirect self-pay if they pay cash out of pocket instead of billing their government plan. The restriction applies only to the savings card, not pure cash-pay programs. Payments through Self-Pay do not apply to Part D deductibles or out-of-pocket maximums.
CLAIM_B_PERMISSION.provenance: WebSearch summary, UNRESTRICTED domains. Underlying links were SECONDARY ONLY (coveredusa.org, findhonestcare.com, polarbearmeds.com, metabolicledger.com, telehealthally.com, trimrx.com, getheally.com). NOT ONE primary source among them.
CLAIM_B_PERMISSION.if_true_engine_behavior: OFFER LillyDirect Self Pay to Medicare/Medicaid users as a cash pathway.
CLAIM_B_PERMISSION.reason_to_doubt: Purely secondary. Commercially interested telehealth and coupon sites have an incentive to describe the cash channel as broadly available. Under the rules of evidence these sources may not confirm anything.

It must NOT be silently presented as available.
extracted.ASYMMETRY_WITH_NOVO_IS_ITSELF_SUSPICIOUS: For Novo, the cash channel (NovoCare Pharmacy) was located as affirmatively OPEN to government-program holders who self-pay, while Novo's savings offer was located as CLOSED to them even if they elect self-pay. That two-tier structure is coherent. If Lilly's cash channel were truly closed to Medicare holders, Lilly's cash channel would be structurally unlike Novo's. Possible, but it raises the prior that CLAIM_A is a document conflation.
